lines: +# Approach: feedback-conditioned retries + dense partial-credit GRPO
+Plain GRPO gets no gradient here: every group is all-zero under the binary reward, and most
+tasks also fail deterministically (e.g. always 6/7 tests), so even the fraction passed has
+zero within-group variance. The plug-in (`/app/algo`, trained from `/app/plugin`) attacks both:
+- **Dense reward** (`algo/reward.py`): training reward = fraction of checker tests passed
+  (via `rlsdk.feedback.parse_verifier_dir`) + 1.0 bonus for a full pass; group-normalized
+  GRPO advantages with a floored std. Logged raw reward stays binary.
+- **Feedback-conditioned retries** (`algo/gen.py`, `algo/agent.py`, `algo/fagent.py`,
+  `algo/state.py`): a fraction of each task's episodes (50%, faded to 35%) get the checker
+  report (`rlsdk.feedback.feedback_text`: test names/counts only) of the best previous
+  failed attempt on that task appended to the instruction, plus a fixed generic checklist
+  sentence. Conditioned and clean episodes share one GRPO group, so conditioned successes
+  push the weights toward the solution and clean failures away from it; clean episodes use
+  the exact evaluation prompt, so the behaviour transfers. Notes refresh every step from
+  that step's best failed episode per task (seeded at step 0 from the screening feedback
+  file, which is the same `rlsdk.feedback` output). Per-episode temperature jitter
+  (0.95-1.12) and rotating fixed generic work-method sentences on conditioned episodes add
+  within-group diversity. The plug-in is task-agnostic: no task ids or task text in code.
+- **Selection**: 18 of the 38 tasks with the highest screening partial-pass rates / shortest
+  episodes (weight 2 for the top 10); 8 tasks x n=8 per step, lr 2e-6, tail cut 300 s.
+## What moved (run fcr1, 80 steps, 5120 episodes)
+- Step 0 already produced the first-ever full passes (conditioned, zp_a84ca724e1c4 2/5).
+- Clean (unconditioned) passes appeared from ~step 10 and compounded. Late training
+  windows (clean episodes = eval distribution): zp_0ad7fa007a10 ~100%, zp_d38a61659d75
+  task_003312_a564e910 passed early (10x) then unlearned; zp_a84ca724e1c4 passes ~25%
+  conditioned but barely clean. The deterministic single-content-test tasks never moved.
+- Eval (k=8, 5 candidate tasks) of the shipped iter-79 export: zp_0ad7fa007a10 7/8,
+  zp_a84ca724e1c4 0/8 (pass@1 0.45 on those five). An iter-69 export scored 0.35, so
+  iter 79 was kept. Expected overall pass@1 ~0.05-0.06, almost all from the first three.
+A chained run (fcr2, from the iter-79 export, narrower selection, lr 1.5e-6) is used to try
+to broaden coverage; the shipped checkpoint is only replaced if it evals better.
